{{Quote|We count 30 Rebel ships, my Lord. But they're so small they're evading our turbolasers.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanbris/Legends|Tanbris]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the Battle of Yavin|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''XX-9 heavy turbolaser''' was a model of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] commonly used the XX-9 aboard its [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].

==Description==
[[File:XX9_Turbolaser_Tower_diagram.png|thumb|left|200px|A diagram of a [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] XX-9 tower on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]]]
The XX-9 was a model of heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. Two versions of the XX-9 were produced; a two-section model that was mounted on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]],<ref name="EGWT" /> and a four-section tower that was installed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]].<ref name="DSOTM">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref> XX-9s were covered in a [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-thick plating of [[Quadanium steel/Legends|Quadanium steel]], and utilized servo-actuated turrets to track targets.<ref name="EGWT" /> The unit had an optimum range of fifteen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], and a maximum range of one hundred kilometers.<ref name="NEGWT" />

The two-section model featured the turret which incorporated two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] [[Barrel/Legends|barrels]] which were capable for elevating through the use of an elevating gun plate and an elevation tracking mechanism. The weapon's [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuator]], [[Energy Coupler]], [[overload dispersal grid]], and [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling unit]] were located in the turret. The weapon's [[capacitor bank]]s and [[Power core/Legends|power core]] were in the section below the swivel mounting. [[Gunner/Legends|Gunnery]] crew stations were located inside the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the vessel itself.<ref name="EGWT" />

The XX-9 variant used aboard the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station was a tower comprising four sections. The first section was the heavy turbolaser battery itself, located at the top. It was capable of rotating in a full circle to provide a full three-hundred-and-sixty degree arc of fire. Dual laser cannons also had swivel mounts to elevate and depress the cannons along the vertical axis. At the top was an external [[Sensor pod/Legends|sensor pod]] as well as elevation gyros. The cooling unit was also located near the top of the battery. The barrels were composed of the laser actuator at the back, followed by the galven coils, as well as the barrels themselves and the emitter tips. The blaster [[gas chamber]] was near the back of the turret, with the overload dispersal grid being located above the swivel mounting.<ref name="DSOTM" />

Rows of capacitor banks were located in the second section, along with power core. Support crew and maintenance stations were housed in the third section, as well as the [[turbine generator]]. The gunnery stations and [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]] were located in the fourth section. The computers were powerful enough to track multiple targets beyond even the [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunners']] helmets' built-in computers. An external maintenance ladder, accessible by a hatch from the third section, ran to the turret.<ref name="DSOTM" />

A safety feature of the targeting computers used by the XX-9s aboard the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station restricted their fire if any portion of the station's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] was in sight. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] exploited this weakness by flying low during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="DSOTM" />

==History==
During the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], XX-9 heavy turbolasers were mounted aboard their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. Each [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was generally equipped with sixty XX-9s.<ref name="EGWT" /> The DS-1 Orbital Battle Station was covered with 5,000 XX-9 heavy turbolasers.<ref name="DSOTM" />

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the turbolasers were found on planet-side engagements, with many destroyed by the Rebels' [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

==Behind the scenes==
A ground-based, single-barreled XX-9 was depicted as the Imperial medium turret in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''. However, unlike its shipboard counterpart, the ground-based XX-9 had its turbine and crew station located within the turret.
